# Update Schedule for Anniversary Realms

WoW Classic The Burning Crusade Classic

[Kaivax](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Kaivax) (Kaivax) January 7, 2026, 6:00pm 1

The Burning Crusade Classic is coming to Anniversary realms, with the Burning Crusade pre-patch arriving next week. Please take note of the following schedule of events.

**24-Hour Maintenance for Anniversary realms**

In the Americas and Oceania region, starting at 3:00 p.m. PST on Monday, January 12, we will take all Anniversary realms offline for maintenance.

Following a 24-hour maintenance period, Anniversary realms will come back online with the Burning Crusade Classic pre-patch.

**Realm Transfer Notices**

Free character transfers from Anniversary Realms to Classic Era realms will close when Anniversary Realms are taken offline for maintenance.

Without help, it is easy to waste hours doing ineffective activities. With Questie, the game becomes so much easier - it structures and places quest objectives directly on your map and minimap. ## WeakAuras

WeakAuras is among the top WoW TBC Classic addons, giving you crucial real-time notifications and explanations for in-game mechanics:

1. Cooldowns
2. Buffs and debuffs
3. Trinket procs
4. Resource thresholds
5. Damage windows timers
6. Boss mechanics alerts

TBC introduces more effects and cooldowns for you to track than Classic, and doing it without addons is suboptimal.

## Description

This addon is a maintained and extended continuation of the original **ClassicCalendar / ClassicAgenda** addon by _Pmptasty_ , which stopped receiving updates in 2025.
Handy for **Guilds** and **Personal** information.  
  
This version restores and expands calendar functionality for **The Burning Crusade Classic (Anniversary Edition)** by adding:

* Full **TBC raid support** (Karazhan through Sunwell Plateau)
* **TBC dungeon listings** , including **Heroic variants**
* **Proper integration into the existing Classic Calendar UI**

The addon preserves the original ClassicCalendar behavior while extending it in a clean, non-intrusive way, making it suitable for guild planning, raid scheduling, and reset tracking in both **Classic Era** and **TBC Classic Anniversary** environments.

Credits: Original ClassicCalendar by **Pmptasty** (2025).
